title: Instax.finance
tagline: Building the next best generation zk-rollups Yield, Bridge, Stableswap experience.
description: A Liquidity Revolution Defi Yielding platform. Built and deployed on multiple zk-rollup  chain a DApp that allows users to receive instance interest on-chain, by providing liquidity, earn yields, bridging assets on various zk-rollups with a mission to scaling Ethereum with fast liquidity & execution.
how_its_made:
The project was with NextJS for better UX-UI experience and Built with Connext Protocol SDK v1.0.3-alpha.0.
- I Integrated Push protocol for users to subscribe and receive update updates about the platform.
- Front-end design we used  Chakra-ui - Create accessible React apps with speed
- Hosting Platform  Platform is hosting on Vercel
